React is part of 4 of my public repositories, from 2015 to 2016.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2), [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [gooddata-graphql](@/work/gooddata-graphql.md): GoodData Web Application Written in Elixir; [maze](@/work/maze.md): Maze Web Application; [gooddata-proxy](@/work/gooddata-proxy.md): GoodData Proxy.

I also used it in client work under confidentiality agreements. Roles: Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer and Data engineer. What was solved: LLM agents, Decision support, AI transformation and Audit trail. The use cases below give the principle and the intent of that work; no client, person, date or number is named.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses React: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links React to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
